text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a few dead anchors and an out-of-date SDK snippet in the Dedicated provisioning doc (autoscale policy section). Opening a small cleanup PR but wanted to sync on the wording for isolation vs. tenant-affinity so it doesn't regress the handbook.
kevin: thanks for calling it out. can you paste the snippet that's wrong?
olivia: :eyes: i saw a user report about `scalePolicy.cooldownSecs` being documented as seconds but the SDK expects millis, right?
maria: exact issue — doc shows `cooldown: 30` which makes it look like 30s, but the SDK example in the repo uses `30000`. i'll include both representations and a note. also there are two anchors that 404 from the TOC — `#tenant-isolation` and `#eviction-behavior`.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7892 — labels: docs, provisioning, quickfix.
sam: quick skim — for isolation wording, i prefer "isolation decorator" language we used in the SLA doc rather than "tenant isolation" to reduce confusion with network isolation. small nit.
maria: good call. i'll align to "isolation decorator" and add a parenthetical about network-level isolation where relevant.
judy: for the autoscale example, can we add a minimal YAML snippet that actually passes `yarn gen:docs`? helps catch anchor changes.
maria: adding a smokeable snippet in the PR. current idea:

```
scalePolicy:
  type: autoscale
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 8
  cooldownMs: 30000
  targetUtilization: 0.6
isolation:
  decorator: tenant-prefer
```

kevin: looks good. minor: use `cooldownMs` field name in the snippet and add an inline comment that some older SDK versions expect `cooldown` in seconds.
maria: will add that note and a migration callout at top of the section.
sam: also add a short test step in the PR description: run `yarn gen:docs && grep -n "tenant-prefer" site/_build` so maintainers can validate anchors.
maria: added test step to PR body and included the anchor corrections — fixed two broken links and updated TOC entries.
olivia: will you add a changelog blurb? small audiences watch handbook diffs.
maria: yep — short changelog under docs/CHANGELOG.md entry: "provisioning: fix anchors, clarify isolation decorator, add autoscale YAML with cooldownMs example".
judy: :thumbsup: please add me as reviewer for wording around SLA overlap; i can sign off on the isolation phrasing.
maria: done — pinged @judy and @kevin in the PR. merging after reviews + CI. if anything slips, we can roll back the TOC changes.
kevin: thanks — good incremental fix. will follow up if downstream SDK examples need separate PRs.
